creator: Alexander Terp
description: Factory run muster-1119-iris, 0.29.0: the lead posted `muster msg post --urgent --no-reply --to indigo` (withdrawing an assignment, 'stand by') to a Codex helper that was working. The helper read it, stopped, said it was standing by, and 42 s after it went to work @muster told the lead it 'went idle without posting ... If you told it to stand by ... post that with --no-reply and Muster will not say this'. The post was --no-reply. Possibly --no-reply is not honored when the post is --urgent, or when it lands in a turn begun by an earlier ordinary post. Also seen in the same run: `muster msg who` said a wake's Returns 'were not taken' on a just-relaunched Codex that had in fact taken the wake and gone to work.
title: A helper told to stand by with --urgent --no-reply is still reported idle without posting
